answer: A farm generating text without memory of its own history therefore fails the binding, which means it has to store and read state per alias. Bindings are kept in plume, verified in grove, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 2 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the mesa check. Repeating the trick 56 times costs 31 separate deposits and 54 separate proofs of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
